The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 92c36602fb496808), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 38. statement: There are smooth one-forms at, ct, 0 ≤ t ≤ 1, with a0 = c0 = 0, such that At = A + dat, Ct = C + dct and (At, Ct, B) is a positive closed triple for every t. For the structure J determined by (A1, C1) and tamed by B, the irreducible curves of class F are precisely the fibers of a smooth proper map pX : X −→ S to a closed connected oriented surface. Each regular fiber is an embedded torus. The singular fibers, if any, are finitely many immersed rational curves, each with one transverse positive double point. Every singular fiber has a neighborhood identified with a proper holomorphic elliptic fibration pY : Y → ∆ with smooth total space, a section, and one ordinary nodal central fiber. In this identification there are constants xi ∈ R, yi ∈ R \ {0} such that (7.1) A1 = Re Σi, C1 = xi Re Σi + yi Im Σi. Here Σi is a nowhere-zero holomorphic two-form, and the model can be chosen with punctured-disk presentation (7.2) z = a + τ(s)b (mod Z + τ(s)Z), τ(s) = log s 2πi , Σi = hi ds ∧ dz, hi ∈ C \ {0}. Both A1 and C1 vanish on every fiber.
